opennyai_summary.11_April_2023__facts:
This is a reference made by the Land Acquisition Collector (hereinafter referred to as 'LAC') under section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as 'LA Act').
As per the reference, a large tract of land measuring 515 bighas and 10 biswas of village Bhorgarh,
Delhi, was acquired by the Government for a public purpose namely construction of 80 meter wide road for development of Narela Township under Planned Development of Delhi.
The notification under Section 4 of The LA Act as mentioned on the index page was issued.
The Declaration under Section 6 LA Act was made as mentioned on the index page.
The LAC determined the market LAC no. 330/16 page 2 of 8 price of the acquired land as Rs.15.70/- lakhs per acre for Category A land, Rs.14 lakhs per acre for Category B land & Rs. 12.3 lakhs per acre for Category C land.
3. The petitioner, being dissatisfied with the market value determined by the LAC, filed the present petition u/s 18 of the LA Act, seeking reference to this court.
The LAC forwarded the same to this Court for adjudication.
The petitioner has challenged the said award inter alia on the ground of inadequacy of compensation and incorrect assessment of market value of land inter-alia due to non-consideration of relevant factors like potentiality and fertility of the suit land, the surrounding colonies and developed areas, the market value of the LAC no. 330/16 page 3 of 8 adjoining areas/villages, the sale deeds of other lands of the contemporary period, nearness to the National Highway and industrial areas, the amenities available in the suit land etc.
7. The respondent no.1/the Union of India (UOI)/Land Acquisition Collector and respondent no.2/Delhi Development Authority (DDA) contested the reference petition by filing their respective Written Statements.
opennyai_summary.11_April_2023__arguments:
8. The petition has been contested mainly on the ground that the LAC awarded adequate compensation to the petitioner after taking into consideration all the relevant factors and therefore,
LAC has correctly assessed the market value of the land after taking into account the market rates prevailing at the time of notification under Section 4 of LA Act.

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
As per the LAC Award, a large tract of land measuring 1074 Bigha of village Pooth Khurd, Delhi, was acquired by the Govt. for a public purpose namely "Rohini Residential Scheme, under Planned Development of Delhi".
The LAC determined the market price of the acquired LAC No.333/19 page 2 of 9 land as Rs.15,70,000/- per acre for land falling in Category 'A' and Rs.14,00,000/- per acre for land falling in 'B' Category.
3.

5.

opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
8. The petition has been contested mainly on the ground that the LAC awarded adequate compensation to the petitioner after taking into consideration all the relevant factors and therefore,
LAC has correctly assessed the market value of the land after taking into account the market rates Sh. Mahender Singh vs Union Of India Through on 9 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30618121/
2 prevailing at the time of notification under Section 4 of LA Act.
The petitioner is accordingly entitled to the same compensation for his land of Category A as was awarded in Randhir Singh's case.
opennyai_summary.final__issue:
The following issues were framed:-
i) Whether the petitioner is entitled to enhancement in compensation, if so, to what amount?
ii) Relief.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
, Hon'ble High Court of Delhi in a case titled as Jai Singh Vs. UOI, LA No.266/08, decided on 23.08.2011 (Delhi High Court) had adopted/used a formula for determination of fair market value of Category B land vis-a-vis land of Category 'A'.
It is a matter of record that the land of Village Pooth Khurd was in consideration before Hon'ble High Court of Delhi while deciding Jai Singh's case (Supra).
Hence, I find no impediment in adopting/relying upon the formula adopted by Hon'ble High Court of Delhi in said case.
In fact this court is under an obligation/duty to follow the orders passed by Hon'ble High Court of Delhi as well as Hon'ble Supreme Court of India.
On applying the formula adopted/used by Hon'ble High Court of Delhi in Jai Singh's case (Supra) the fair market value of category B land of village Pooth Khurd acquired by same Notification is calculated to be 2.5% lesser than the market value of category A land.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Hence, the market value of category B land of Village Pooth Khurd acquired by same Notification is adjudicated to be Rs.19,31,231/- per acre.
